title: Create tasks.csv File

title: Add Input Validation Library
description: Create .claude/lib/input-validation.sh with validate_task_id(), sanitize_path(), and validate_workspace_dir() functions. Prevents command injection (CWE-78) vulnerabilities.

title: Patch atomic-plan.md with Input Validation
description: Add input validation to atomic-plan.md command. Source validation library and call validate_task_id() before using TASK_ID in any commands. Fixes command injection vulnerability.

title: Patch execute-task.md with Input Validation
description: Add input validation to execute-task.md command. Source validation library and call validate_task_id() before using TASK_ID. Prevents path traversal and command injection attacks.

title: Harden Permissions in settings.local.json
description: Replace wildcard permissions (ssh:*, pip install:*, export:*) with whitelist-based specific command allowances. Add deny list for dangerous commands (rm, curl, sudo).

title: Create Root README.md
description: Create comprehensive README.md with installation instructions, quick start guide, architecture overview, and links to documentation. Critical for onboarding new users.

title: Implement Automated Workspace Cleanup
description: Create .claude/cron/workspace-cleanup.sh script that runs weekly via cron to clean up abandoned workspaces (>30 days old, <10% progress). Includes logging and optional email notifications.

title: Resolve Duplicate Workspace Directories
description: Investigate duplicate workspaces in workspace/ and .claude/workspace/. Create symlink from workspace -> .claude/workspace for backward compatibility. Update documentation to clarify canonical location.

title: Add Workspace Size Monitoring
description: Create .claude/lib/workspace-monitoring.sh with functions: get_workspace_size(), get_workspace_count(), check_workspace_limit(), get_oldest_workspace(). Integrate with atomic-plan.md to warn when limits approached.

title: Extract Shared Workspace Functions
description: Create .claude/lib/workspace-functions.sh with get_workspace_dir(), get_workspace_file(), get_checklist_progress(), workspace_exists(). Refactor 12 files to use shared functions. Reduces 47 lines of code duplication.

title: Optimize Cleanup-Workspaces File I/O
description: Replace multiple grep calls with single awk command in cleanup-workspaces.md. Read each checklist file once instead of 3 times. Expected 40% performance improvement.

title: Split Dashboard Template into Modular Files
description: Extract CSS from dashboard.html (lines 7-277) to dashboard.css. Extract JavaScript (lines 396-442) to dashboard.js. Update HTML to use external links. Reduces template size by 68%.
